name: हर्बर्ट की पंचपदी पाठ योजना (Herbart's Five Step Model of Teaching)
description:
📚 Topic : हर्बर्ट की पंचपदी पाठ योजना (Herbart's Five Step Model of Teaching)

📖 Definition (English):
Herbart's Five Step Model is a systematic method of lesson planning proposed by Johann Friedrich Herbart. It helps teachers teach in a logical and organized manner.

📖 परिभाषा (हिंदी):
हर्बर्ट की पंचपदी पाठ योजना, जोहान फ्रेडरिक हर्बर्ट द्वारा प्रतिपादित एक वैज्ञानिक एवं क्रमबद्ध शिक्षण विधि है। इसमें शिक्षण को पाँच चरणों में सम्पन्न किया जाता है।

👨‍🏫 Psychologist : Johann Friedrich Herbart (जोहान फ्रेडरिक हर्बर्ट)

  • ✔ Father of Scientific Pedagogy (वैज्ञानिक शिक्षाशास्त्र के जनक)
  • ✔ Propounded Five Step Model of Teaching.
  • ✔ Emphasized Interest Theory (रुचि का सिद्धांत)
  • ✔ Stressed Moral Education (नैतिक शिक्षा)
  • ✔ Teaching should move from Known to Unknown.

🎯 Five Steps of Herbart Model (पंचपदी पाठ योजना)

Step English हिंदी Description
1 Preparation प्रस्तावना / तैयारी Teacher connects previous knowledge with new lesson.
2 Presentation प्रस्तुतीकरण New topic is taught using examples, charts and activities.
3 Comparison / Association तुलना / संबंध Students compare new knowledge with previous knowledge.
4 Generalization सामान्यीकरण Students derive rules, principles and conclusions.
5 Application अनुप्रयोग Students apply learning in real-life situations.

📚 TET Important Points

  • ✅ Five Step Lesson Plan → Johann Friedrich Herbart
  • ✅ Number of Steps → 5
  • ✅ Scientific and Teacher-Centered Approach
  • ✅ Focus on Moral Development
  • ✅ Based on Psychological Principles of Interest
  • ✅ Frequently asked in CTET, UPTET, SUPER TET, KVS & DSSSB.

📝 Easy Trick (Exam Trick)

👉 PPAGA Rule

  1. Preparation (प्रस्तावना)
  2. Presentation (प्रस्तुतीकरण)
  3. Association / Comparison (तुलना / संबंध)
  4. Generalization (सामान्यीकरण)
  5. Application (अनुप्रयोग)

Mnemonic: PPAGA → Prepare → Present → Associate → Generalize → Apply
